name: Finally recursion
description: Runaway recursion through finally blocks and catch filters leaves the game alive, a ping following each check: a runaway the code catches, and a static initializer that does not recurse, answer success; every other case answers an error. Cases: a static initializer; a runaway caught twice in a row; a finally whose cleanup runs before the runaway is caught; recursion inside a finally from a void method, a method returning a value, a method with an argument, a generic method, a constructor, and a finally that also calls compiled code; a finally that throws; using and lock cleanup, the lock checked free from another thread; a throwing catch filter; a filter that calls compiled code; deep finite recursion with a throwing finally; an iterator's finally. Its first step stops the run on a mod build without the handler guard.

params.code: return typeof(MainThreadDispatcher).GetMethod("SkipHandler") != null;
public static class Stat4 { public static int v; static Stat4() { v = 7; } }
return Stat4.v;
public static class Rt4 { public static int Depth(int d) { return Depth(d + 1); } }
string a = "", b = ""; try { Rt4.Depth(0); } catch (Exception e) { a = e.GetType().Name; } try { Rt4.Depth(0); } catch (Exception e) { b = e.GetType().Name; } return a + "/" + b;
public static class Rf4 { public static int cleaned; public static void Clean() { cleaned++; } public static void R() { try { R(); } finally { Clean(); } } }
try { Rf4.R(); } catch (Exception e) { return e is Unity_Inspector_Mod.MainThreadDispatcher.RunawayRecursionException && Rf4.cleaned > 0; } return false;
public static class Rz4 { public static void F() { try { F(); } finally { F(); } } }
Rz4.F(); return 1;
public static class Rs4 { public static string G() { try { return G(); } finally { G(); } } }
return Rs4.G();
public static class Rj4 { public static int H(int d) { try { return H(d + 1); } finally { H(d + 1); } } }
return Rj4.H(0);
public static class Rg4 { public static T K<T>() { try { return K<T>(); } finally { K<T>(); } } }
return Rg4.K<int>();
public class Rc4 { public Rc4() { try { new Rc4(); } finally { new Rc4(); } } }
new Rc4(); return 1;
public static class Ry4 { static object O() { return new object(); } public static void F() { try { F(); } finally { F(); O().ToString(); } } }
Ry4.F(); return 1;
public static class Rx4 { public static void F() { try { F(); } finally { throw new InvalidOperationException("from finally"); } } }
Rx4.F(); return 1;

public static class Ru4 { public static int disposed; class D : IDisposable { public void Dispose() { disposed++; } } public static readonly object gate = new object(); public static void R() { lock (gate) { using (new D()) { R(); } } } }

try { Ru4.R(); } catch (Exception e) { bool free = false; var t = new System.Threading.Thread(() => { free = System.Threading.Monitor.TryEnter(Ru4.gate); if (free) System.Threading.Monitor.Exit(Ru4.gate); }); t.Start(); t.Join(); return e.GetType().Name + " disposed=" + Ru4.disposed + " lockFree=" + free; } return "no throw";
public static class Rw4 { public static void F() { try { F(); } catch (Exception e) when (e.Data["x"].ToString() == "") { } } }
Rw4.F(); return 1;
public static class Rk4 { static bool Deep(int d) { return d > 50 ? false : Deep(d + 1); } public static void F() { try { F(); } catch (Exception e) when (Deep(0)) { } } }
Rk4.F(); return 1;
public static class Rv4 { public static void F(int n) { try { if (n > 0) F(n - 1); else throw new Exception("bottom"); } finally { throw new InvalidOperationException("from finally"); } } }
Rv4.F(3000); return 1;
public static class Ri4 { static IEnumerable<int> Seq() { try { yield return 1; } finally { Walk(); } } public static void Walk() { foreach (int x in Seq()) { Walk(); } } }
Ri4.Walk(); return 1;
